gameDescriptionHtml:
Shui’s Odyssey is a narrative-driven puzzle game that tightly integrates storytelling and gameplay.

This is a puzzle game that combines text and images. Players use visual illusions to piece together fragments of memories from Alzheimer’s patients, in order to reconstruct the truth of the story and witness the passage of time for three generations.

Game Features

  • Experience the passage of time for three generations – Players will join the protagonist, “Xiao Shui,” on a profound journey to rediscover lost memories and embark on a soul-searching quest. Through themes of love, family, and friendship, players will uncover emotional chapters of life set against the backdrop of a significant era.
  • Imaginative visual puzzles – As the game unfolds, players will encounter a series of intricate visual illusions, akin to the unveiling of a scroll, gradually revealing the truth behind the story.
  • Exquisite original hand-drawn illustrations – Featuring a wealth of delicate and stunning artwork and animations, a script inspired by real-life experiences, and meticulously designed gameplay mechanics, Shui’s Odyssey offers a captivating gaming experience.
